deadline.value: Fall 2027 priority deadline is December 1, 2026; applications after it are still considered.
deadline.quote: Fall 2027: The deadline for priority consideration is December 1, 2026.

funding.value: Entering students who make satisfactory progress get a stipend of at least $27,000 from a GRA or GTA for at least 5 years.
funding.quote: will receive an annual stipend of at least $27,000 either from a Graduate Research Assistantship (GRA) or a Graduate Teaching Assistantship (GTA) for at least 5 years in the program

notes: Pharmaceutical and medicinal chemistry PhDs are in the School of Pharmacy and are not covered here.
